h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in South Dum Dum

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in South Dum Dum

items.pText: Open ground is scarce in South Dumdum, so many newer housing projects put their children's play area on a podium or a terrace. Equipment on a concrete slab cannot be fixed the way it is in a garden. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for these sites, and for schools and parks, at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,650 km away.

South Dumdum lies in the northern part of the Kolkata metropolitan area, close to the airport, with dense housing and a humid climate. Our own team or a dealer in eastern India handles installation after road delivery. First tell us whether your site is on natural ground or on a slab. Then share the size and a few photos, and we will suggest equipment with a layout drawing marking the safe play area.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Play areas on podiums and terraces

c: A podium slab has waterproofing that must not be broken, so digging pits for grouted footings is not possible. Self-standing equipment, which rests on its own base, is the usual answer. Ask your structural engineer to confirm that the slab can carry the load of the equipment and the children using it.

items.q: Can playground equipment be installed on a terrace or podium?
items.a: Yes, using self-standing equipment that does not need pits. Your structural engineer should confirm the slab can take the load before we finalise the layout.

items.q: What flooring goes on a concrete slab?
items.a: Rubber flooring. It cushions falls and protects the slab surface. Keep drainage outlets open so rainwater does not collect under it.

items.q: Do you supply schools and parks in South Dumdum too?
items.a: Yes. We supply schools, housing complexes, clubs and municipal parks, and we deliver by road to any part of the Kolkata metropolitan area.
